meta.description: Standard single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline. Use for QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction (PCA/UMAP/t-SNE), clustering, differential expression, visualization, and converting R-friendly single-cell formats such as Seurat or SingleCellExperiment RDS files into h5ad for Scanpy. Best for exploratory scRNA-seq analysis with established workflows.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of scanpy capabilities with proper version documentation (1.12.x)

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for single-cell RNA-seq analysis with clear tool boundaries (scvi-tools for deep learning, anndata for data format)

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established single-cell analysis methods (Leiden clustering, UMAP, differential expression)

code_usability.detail: Comprehensive bundled scripts (13 CLIs) are syntactically correct with shared helper module

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of scRNA-seq workflow: QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction, clustering, markers, visualization, R interop

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability with 13 bundled scripts, shared helper module, sensible defaults, raw-count preservation

performance_context.note: Well-organized with script toolkit table, step-by-step chain examples, one-shot pipeline option, reference documentation

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with 'prefer scripts over writing code' directive, complete script table, chaining examples, R interop guide

human_usability.note: Clear installation with Python 3.12+ requirement, [leiden] extra documented, all scripts have --help

security.note: Excellent security: local file operations only, no network calls, bounded outputs via scripts, safe relative paths

maintainability.note: Version 1.5, BSD-3-Clause license, current stable release documented (scanpy 1.12.x, January 2026)

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with explicit tool boundaries (scvi-tools, anndata), script-first approach; minor: config JSON schema not fully documented

key_strengths: Exceptional bundled tooling with 13 ready-to-run CLI scripts covering entire scRNA-seq workflow, reducing code-writing burden
